tbesh_html:
1) to steal, steal away, carry away
1a) (Qal) to steal
1b) (Niphal) to be stolen
1c) (Piel) to steal away
1d)(Pual) to be stolen away, be brought by stealth
1e) (Hithpael) to go by stealth, steal away

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to thieve (literally or figuratively); by implication, to deceive
strongs_1890.kjv_def: carry away, [idiom] indeed, secretly bring, steal (away), get by stealth.
